name: Bar Swell
description: Up and down again over a bar: slow movement for a pad.

name: Eighth Gate
description: Open for one sixteenth, shut for the next: a held pad chopped into a pulse.

name: Eighth Pump
description: A short duck every eighth note, not quite all the way down: a bass or a chord that bounces.

name: Filter Pump
description: The duck on the volume, and a low pass that opens with each beat and closes after it: pumping and breathing.

name: Long Duck
description: A deeper, slower breath on each beat, the sound coming back only just before the next: the house pump.

name: Note Duck
description: The duck starts with each note the track plays rather than on the grid, as a kick's own sidechain would.

name: Offbeat Pump
description: The duck moved half a beat on, so the sound comes up on the beat and dips on the offbeat.

name: Quarter Duck
description: The duck a sidechained compressor gives under a four-to-the-floor kick: down on each beat, held a moment, and back up quickly. On a pad, a bass or a whole bus.

name: Trance Gate
description: Every sixteenth cut short, the trance gate on a supersaw.
